verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms a populated llms.txt at developers.heygen.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200), and a marketing-site llms.txt also exists at www.heygen.com/llms.txt. First-party docs state that every endpoint ships with llms.txt and typed schemas so agents like Claude and Cursor can consume them, and the llms.txt entries cover endpoints from video creation to scopes and wallets. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec at standard paths (the probe returned 404 on all candidates), and no independent reports of agents actually using the docs.
